1.t: In the name of Allah, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.

2.t: Praise be to Allah, the Cherisher and Sustainer of the worlds;

4.t: Master of the Day of Judgment.

5.t: Thee do we worship, and Thine aid we seek.

7.t: The way of those on whom Thou hast bestowed Thy Grace, those whose (portion) is not wrath, and who go not astray.
